scope: Independent Tiny deferred/lifetime and detected-abort test sufficiency; no production approval
assessment: Actual sockets and real TinyHttpdExchange lifecycle establish late JSON/owned stream, pending Deferred success/reject/upload ownership, detected-abort cleanup and bounded shutdown; initial callback return is observed explicitly before late work.

Late SSE tests require worker wakeup, dedicated log once, zero retained slots, one-slot admission with writable503-rejection control, cancel-before-drain on accepted attach abort, and retention of a running drain slot until it truly exits after stop.

Controlled public ResponseWrapper faults target real adapter commit/output-write/output-flush/final-flush seams; terminal failure must propagate IO, notify early/late once outside exchange monitor despite throwing observers, release worker/slots and abort transport once. Finish failure cannot be hidden as successful completion.
Concurrent registration versus repeated abort exercises actual built-in exchange subscribers, with total callback counts after joined futures, late registration and captured outside-lock assertions.

Actual SO_LINGER reset while reading is distinguished from writable EOF protocol400 and body-read408, which must retain complete recoverable response and zero abort notifications. Existing413/limit socket and body-mapping suites remain regression controls.

Real upload and owned-service checks prove resource release after settlement/abort/shutdown and no resurrection/double log on late settlement; no mocked expected outcome substitutes for socket observations.

Failure log shows12 concrete behavior gaps (missing callbacks, late-SSE rejection, missing drain cancellation/final-flush detection) and six positive controls, with zero errors/skips. Existing socket and common-core helpers are reused.
limitations: Shared AbortListeners reuse is a production implementation gate under IR-HTTP-009 AC-3; tests specify semantics without requiring a particular implementation layout.
All18 tests and retained adapter limit/security/WS/SSE suites must subsequently pass GREEN. This review does not claim whole-feature verification.
actions: No repository changes or builds; only tmp review artifact written. Stop at first PASS.
